text: If someone is worried about a bleed, I'd probably skip DMSO, but it depends on how severe their issue is. It's not a powerful blood thinner like heparin, unless maybe injected; it's basically a dietary blood thinner. I've never had any issues with bleeding too much from consuming DMSO, and never heard of it either, but if bleeding is already a medical issue I'd want to think about that more. They can feel better on DMSO with a clot or a bleed still there. So if any of the checks above fail, call medics right away, before the window for treating a stroke closes.
